root_cause: V1 uses a broad current-style equity universe without point-in-time membership fields.
affected_data: adjusted_close_panel.csv; csm001_construct_state.csv; tsm001_construct_state.csv; downstream workflow artifacts
remediation_method: Replace or supplement universe with point-in-time eligible universe membership or explicitly freeze V2 as non-production research-only if unavailable.
source_of_truth: Historical constituent/member database or documented PIT universe source
validation_test: For each date, verify every tradable symbol was eligible/listed as of that date.

root_cause: Delisted and failed securities are not demonstrably included in V1 universe/data coverage.
affected_data: price panel; construct states; workflow selected securities
remediation_method: Add delisted security coverage and listing/delisting lifecycle handling, or explicitly classify survivorship bias as unresolved.
source_of_truth: Survivorship-aware vendor/source with delisting dates and returns where available
validation_test: Verify delisted symbols appear before delisting and are excluded after delisting; document missing delisting returns if unavailable.

root_cause: Point-in-time membership metadata is absent or incomplete in frozen V1 artifacts.
remediation_method: Create PIT eligibility table with effective dates for listing, delisting, and universe membership.
source_of_truth: PIT membership source or reproducible eligibility policy
validation_test: Random and full-sample checks that eligibility is evaluated only with information available at date t.

root_cause: Signal timing policy separates rebalance signal formation from next-period return measurement.
remediation_method: Carry forward timing policy without modification; re-audit in DBA-002 after V2 rebuild.
source_of_truth: WPC-001 and WPC-002 frozen protocol artifacts
validation_test: Confirm no same-close return capture and no future return leakage.

root_cause: Adjusted prices are used, but independent corporate action verification is not frozen.
remediation_method: Document corporate action source and run split/dividend adjustment sanity checks against source metadata where available.
source_of_truth: Price vendor corporate action files or equivalent documentation
validation_test: Check for discontinuities around split/dividend dates and compare adjusted series behavior.

root_cause: Liquidity/capacity was partially supported but not production authorized.
remediation_method: Carry WLC limitations forward into V2 and later capacity gates; do not treat as production readiness.
validation_test: Confirm liquidity fields and limitations are preserved in baseline documentation.

root_cause: General data integrity requires revalidation after any data rebuild.
remediation_method: Run deterministic integrity checks after V2 data build: duplicates, missingness, date coverage, stale prices, invalid OHLC relationships if OHLCV used.
validation_test: Produce DBA-002 data integrity report with pass/fail domain statuses.
